description: Agent preflight round 2: check an A2A agent card before you rely on the agent. Input card as JSON (name, description, url, provider, version, skills, securitySchemes and security or authentication, capabilities) or the same JSON as text. The signed report marks each card element present or missing and checks the card against itself: the card URL and every other published address on HTTPS and a public host, every skill with an id, a name and a description, every authentication requirement backed by a named scheme with the fields its type needs, and capabilities declared as true or false. POST /api/agent-card-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no registry or chain lookup, no counterparty contact, and no payment signed, submitted or moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-preflight-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/preflight/.
